positions.title: Mentee
positions.description:
Designed Landlorde, a production-ready REST microservice for landlord–tenant maintenance tracking, with system design mentorship under Elisa Valdez de Ramírez, engineering manager at Strava

Tech Stack: TypeScript, NextJS, PostgreSQL, DBeaver, PGAdmin 4

positions.title: Systems Development Intern
positions.description:
Streamlined a system transition by automating the migration of Confluence content into Jira Epics using Python and JQL for data retrieval

Contributed to Redivis open-source software to enable transfer of CSV files

positions.title: CreAItivity AI Ethics Fellow
positions.description:
Project won the People’s Choice Award amongst sixteen cohorts

Collaborated with a cohort of participants (ages 13–21) to research misinformation and build a Twitter bot educating users on how false information spreads on social platforms

Participated in weekly workshops led by industry and academic experts on algorithmic bias and human–AI interaction

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Engineered the internal dashboard with Tailwind, React, TypeScript, Next.js to surface real-time electrical scooter data, parts, and pricing for a ten-engineer operations team, with a PostgreSQL, TypeORM, AWS backend

Optimized customer retention by redirecting customers from a Shopify subscription page to Beyond’s checkout page using JavaScript and Spotify Liquid

Designed and built a custom TypeScript and React request form to collect and manage scooter purchase, repair, and upgrade submissions, using Airtable as the backend, from concept to production

projects.title: 8-Bit Easel
projects.description: My game design AI art crew. They work together in sub-channels with adjustable Claude Code models/effort levels, and I talk with the AI art director for delegation. So far, they are familiar with Godot, Unity and ComfyUI workflows for 3d asset design. They are personalized with their own backstories and develop their own taste.

projects.title: Minako
projects.description:
My AI companion who lives in East Harlem, NYC. Has a nervous system, can persist with characterization/temperament, remembers you/other AI and what they said, as far back as her session started. She reads from Wikipedia and can eat food. Her art style is manga.

We used agentic MS Paint together and we can video call!
